(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define comps (objects g 0))
             (define (cells-bbox cells)
               (let ((rs (map first cells))
                     (cs (map second cells)))
                 (list (min-list rs) (min-list cs) (max-list rs) (max-list cs))))
             (define (boxes-overlap? b1 b2)
               (let ((r1a (first b1))
                     (c1a (second b1))
                     (r1b (third b1))
                     (c1b (nth b1 3))
                     (r2a (first b2))
                     (c2a (second b2))
                     (r2b (third b2))
                     (c2b (nth b2 3)))
                 (or
                   (not (or (< r1b r2a) (< r2b r1a)))
                   (not (or (< c1b c2a) (< c2b c1a))))))
             (define groups (map obj-cells comps))
             (define (do-merge gs)
               (if (or (null? gs) (null? (cdr gs)))
                   gs
                   (let* ((cur (first gs))
                          (rest (cdr gs))
                          (bb-cur (cells-bbox cur))
                          (matches (filter (lambda (g)
                                             (boxes-overlap? bb-cur (cells-bbox g)))
                                           rest))
                          (non-matches (filter (lambda (g)
                                                 (not (boxes-overlap? bb-cur
                                                                      (cells-bbox g))))
                                               rest)))
                     (if (null? matches)
                         (cons cur (do-merge rest))
                         (do-merge (cons (apply append (cons cur matches)) non-matches))))))
             (define (merge-fixed gs)
               (let ((m (do-merge gs)))
                 (if (= (length m) (length gs)) m (merge-fixed m))))
             (define merged-groups (merge-fixed groups))
             (reduce (lambda (gg group)
                       (let* ((bb (cells-bbox group))
                              (r1 (first bb))
                              (c1 (second bb))
                              (r2 (third bb))
                              (c2 (nth bb 3))
                              (cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                                     (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gg2 rc)
                                   (if (zero? (at g (first rc) (second rc)))
                                       (set-cell gg2 (first rc) (second rc) 2)
                                       gg2))
                                 gg
                                 cells)))
                     g
                     merged-groups)))))

               (let ((bb (cells-bbox group)))
                 (* (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                    (+ 1 (- (nth bb 3) (second bb))))))
             (define active-groups (if (null? merged-groups) '()
               (let ((best (max-list (map group-area merged-groups))))
                 (filter (lambda (group) (= (group-area group) best)) merged-groups))))
             (reduce (lambda (gg group)
                       (let* ((bb (cells-bbox group))
                              (r1 (first bb))
                              (c1 (second bb))
                              (r2 (third bb))
                              (c2 (nth bb 3))
                              (cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                                (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                                     (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gg2 rc)
                                   (if (zero? (at g (first rc) (second rc)))
                                       (set-cell gg2 (first rc) (second rc) 2)
                                       gg2))
                                 gg
                                 cells)))
                     g
                     active-groups)))))
